_readme: HOW TO UPDATE: edit the "entries" list below (one object per milestone) and save/commit the file.
year    - the year (numbers are shown in Bengali numerals automatically), required
title   - short heading in Bangla, required
titleEn - the same heading in English (used for the year row tooltip / accessibility)
desc    - one or two sentences of detail in Bangla
descEn  - ONE short result-first English line (max ~90 chars). This is an orientation
line for readers who do not read Bangla - it is NOT a translation of desc.
tag     - optional Bangla chip label, e.g. "সূচনা" / "নতুন অর্জন"
tagEn   - the chip in English (the chip itself renders in English uppercase)
Order does not matter: the page sorts newest-first automatically (change "sort" to "oldest-first" if you prefer).
OPTIONAL NO-CODE MODE: put a published Google Sheet CSV URL in "sheetCsvUrl" below and the page will read
the timeline straight from that sheet (columns: year,title,desc,tag - add titleEn/descEn/tagEn for English).
ACCESS: only someone with access to this file (the repository) or to that sheet can change the timeline.
The published website is read-only: it only ever sends GET requests and renders every value as escaped text.
